title: Launch Clarity Docket and Staffflow Map
body:
Purpose:
- Single-page working docket to translate product roadmap milestones into a concrete staffflow and KPI watchlist for the 14-day prelaunch -> launch -> 72h post-launch window.
- Emphasis on clarity for who is ON-DECK vs ON-CALL vs ESCALATION OWNER. Quick, scannable for on-call rotations.

Scope:
- Applies to hosted API feature rollout + optional dedicated-pool promo (affects capacity planning). Not the full launch playbook (that lives in prodops launch-runbook). This is the STAFF & KPI clarity layer.

High-level timeline (anchor dates)
- Feature freeze: 2024-11-18
- Smoke + canary window: 2024-11-20 -> 2024-11-26
- Beta traffic ramp: 2024-11-27 -> 2024-12-03
- Public launch: 2024-12-04 09:00 PT
- 72h critical window: 2024-12-04 -> 2024-12-07

Critical path items (must be green to proceed)
- Canary endpoints instrumented with per-route latency and token-cost metrics (ENG-OBS-78) - owner: Marcus Lee
- Load test pass at 2x projected peak with <5% p95 latency degradation (INFRA-503) - owner: Sofia Alvarez
- Revert plan validated with traffic-steering knob (ROUTE-11) - owner: Priya Nair
- Billing / quotas gating for free-credits bump (FIN-88) - owner: Benji Park

Top-5 KPIs to watch (definitions + thresholds)
1) Request success rate (5xx + client errors) - target >= 99.8% (alert at 99.5%)
2) p95 response latency (generate endpoint) - target < 750ms for hosted; < 400ms for dedicated (alert at +25%)
3) Cost per 1k tokens (observed) - baseline vs forecast (alert if > forecast + 20%)
4) Model quality regression score (eval set) - baseline pass: no category drop > 3 percentage points
5) Queue length / batch wait time - target < 50ms average (alert if > 200ms)

Alert routing & thresholds (quick)
- Pager for SRE if KPI 1 or 2 crosses alert within two minutes.
- Product owner (Avery Chen) Slack @channel for persistent cost anomalies (> 30 min).
- On-call ENG lead (Marcus) is first escalation for throughput/capacity alerts; SRE takes infra-level faults.

Staffflow map (14-day pre -> 72h post):
- Role: Launch Commander (day-of) -> Priya Nair (08:00-20:00 PT)
- Role: Product lead (decision & comms) -> Avery Chen (on-call 24/7 first 72h)
- Role: ENG on-call (latency/500s) -> Marcus Lee (rota 06:00-18:00 PT), backup Sofia (18:00-06:00 PT)
- Role: SRE capacity lead -> Sofia Alvarez (prelaunch capacity tuning, load test owner)
- Role: Billing escalation -> Benji Park (business-hours) / finance-ops on-call (overnight)
- Role: Customer success escalation -> Tara Jenkins (02:00-14:00 PT overlapping with first wave)

Shift handover template (for each 12h block) - copy into Slack thread at shift change:
- Time window 
- Top 3 open incidents (status + ETA to resolution)
- KPI headroom summary (latency, success rate, cost)
- Config changes in last 3h (who, why, revert link)
- Next 3h watch items

Smoke test checklist (pre-canary quick run):
- [ ] Basic generate route returns deterministic small token response (<250ms local env)
- [ ] Streaming path opens, partial outputs seen within 120ms
- [ ] Auth & rate limit headers present and consistent for test tokens
- [ ] Embeddings route sanity: cosine similarity stable vs baseline (small set)
- [ ] Canary traffic rule deployed to 0.5% users, telemetry live

Contingency triggers & immediate actions (cheat sheet)
- Trigger: p95 latency > threshold AND success-rate drop > 0.5% for 5m -> Action: engage SRE, throttle non-critical routes, flip traffic to dedicated fallback variant.
- Trigger: sustained cost spike > 25% for 30m -> Action: pause promotional quota, notify finance, enable cost-busted routing policy.
- Trigger: quality regression on eval set (category drop > 3pp) -> Action: rollout halt, rollback to previous model variant, notify product & CS, open postmortem.

Quick decision matrix (who can greenlight rollback)
- Product + SRE lead together can authorize immediate rollback during first 72h. Exec notification if customer-impacting (> 1% of active customers) or outage > 30m.

Open questions / risks (notes to self)
- Do we have a documented SLA for the promo dedicated pool? (finance/legal check) -> FIN-88 outstanding.
- Night-owl coverage: need a second backup for Marcus overnight on day 0-3.
- Telemetry retention: are the token-cost finer-grained metrics kept for 14 days? If not, increase sampling.

Action items (owner -> ticket)
- Marcus: final canary dashboard + alert config -> PRODOPS-321 (in progress)
- Sofia: scale test results + capacity knobs -> PRODOPS-322 (blocked: infra quota)
- Priya: comms template for customers + status page updates -> COMMS-19
- Avery: finalize staff rota and approve overtime plan -> HR-47

Hand-off: paste this docket into the launch command-pad at T-24h and pin to /product-ops channel.

Notes (format: messy, intentionally)
- Keep this file minimal — the heavy checklists live in the launch-runbook and the SRE playbook. This is the clarity layer that answers: who is doing what now, and which 3 KPIs do we watch right now.
- If you are reading at 03:00 and no one's awake: follow the immediate actions above, escalate to SRE paging, and post short status in #product-ops.

Revision history:
- 2024-11-05: initial draft (Avery)
- 2024-11-19: added smoke checklist + staffflow (Marcus)
- 2024-12-07: updated public launch time + decision matrix (Priya)
